label: Whatever causes the being of everything else enters into the composition of nothing
paraphrase: Open bridge, analyst formulation, unattributed: whatever causes the being of everything else that is in act as to being is a component of nothing (RemoteFromAll). After ST I q.3 a.8's reason that the first efficient cause is not numerically one with the form or matter of what it makes. Gives Dei Filius's 'really distinct from the world' only in that reading.
